references.text: Parallel text about the eighth day with a holy assembly and offerings during the Feast of Tabernacles, with detailed sacrifice regulations
Describes the Feast of Tabernacles lasting seven days with a holy assembly and a prohibition on work
The introduction to the Feast of Tabernacles of which this verse is part, with the first day as a holy assembly
Repeats the instructions about the eighth day as a solemn day after seven days of celebration
Nehemiah describes the celebration of the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days with a festive gathering on the eighth day
Jesus speaks on the last and greatest day of the feast, referring to the eighth day of the Feast of Tabernacles
The same pattern of holy assembly and prohibition on work as at the Feast of Unleavened Bread
Moses' instructions to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days
